description: Take collateral back out of your obligation and redeem it to bCOOK in the same transaction (`keepShares` leaves the abCOOK shares in your wallet instead). `amount` is in bCOOK, or "all". Refuses before signing if the remaining loan would exceed its loan-to-value limit or leave the health factor under `minHealthFactor` (default 1.1; 1.0 is the liquidation line). Frozen while the bCOOK oracle is unhealthy. Simulates first. Requires a signer: COOKIE_PRIVATE_KEY locally, or in external-signer mode this returns `needs_signature` for the user's wallet to sign (see submit_signed_tx).

asset.description: collateral asset; only needed with several

keepShares.description: keep the abCOOK share tokens instead of redeeming them for bCOOK

minHealthFactor.description: refuse if the health factor after would be lower (default 1.1)

name: withdraw_collateral
title: Withdraw collateral from Aera
